description: This Python script sets up a conversational bot pipeline integrating speech-to-text, language model processing, and text-to-speech services. It manages various transport options, registers functions for external API calls like weather retrieval, and defines event handlers for client connections. The code uses Pipecat framework components to construct and run the pipeline asynchronously.
